mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows a 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, indicating a tight monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When both Real Final Sales (RSAFS) and Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 2% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand and housing market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2% MoM
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and housing market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in one month signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, an increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% MoM during a late-cycle expansion.
